Every POV from @valentinsimonet at the legendary Pike's Peak Hill Climb 🎥 Captured on #GoProMISSION1 PRO in 8K Open Gate.

🏁 Pike's Peak is the 2nd oldest motorsports race in the US—this year was the 107th edition. The time-trail race starts at over 9,000 ft of elevation + climbs a 12 mile, winding road with no guard rails to the 14,000ft finish line, pushing what is possible for both driver + machine.

#PikesPeak #Colorado #Motorsports
